lines.en: label yumiyukispecial1:
scene yukiyumibar1
: Yo.
: Wh...What the fuck are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 什……你他妈在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Got a call that the “princess” was back at the Yamaguchi place. Figured I’d drop by and see what sorta shit could’ve caused that.
lines.zh: : 接到消息说「公主」回山口家了。想着顺道过来看看，到底出了什么破事能让你回来。

lines.en: : That’s not...your mom, is it?
lines.zh: : 这位不是……你妈妈吧？

lines.en: : It’s the bitch who used to be my mom. Ain’t had that role in a long fuckin’ time.
lines.zh: : 是曾经当过我妈的那个婊子。这角色她很久没演了。

lines.en: : Hey, like it or not, I still carried you around for nine months. That’s gotta be worth something.
lines.zh: : 嘿，不管你乐不乐意，我好歹怀了你九个月。总得值点什么吧。

lines.en: : Might’ve been if you hadn’t immediately forgotten me right afterwards. The fuck you want?
lines.zh: : 要是你之后没马上把我忘干净，也许还值点。你到底想干嘛？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar2
: Chill. I already told you why I’m here. Also, who’s this? Since when do you talk to anyone without a dick?
lines.zh: : 别激动。我不是说了来意吗。还有，这位是谁？你什么时候开始跟没长鸡巴的人说话了？

lines.en: : Chika Chosokabe...
lines.zh: : Chika Chosokabe……

lines.en: : Yuki Yamaguchi. Pleasure.
lines.zh: : Yuki Yamaguchi。幸会。

lines.en: : Why the fuck are you even using that name still?
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么还在用那个姓？

lines.en: : Same reason as you, probably. It’s nice makin’ those fuckers at the gate bow for us, ain’t it? Makes you feel all important and shit.
lines.zh: : 大概跟你的理由一样吧。看着门口那帮混蛋给我们鞠躬还挺爽的，不是吗？让人觉得自己挺了不起之类的。

lines.en: : Just because I came back home doesn’t mean I’m suddenly just ready to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : 我回这个家，不代表我就突然准备好要跟你说话了。

lines.en: : Gotcha. So your {i}dad{/i} is fine but I’m still meant to just stay the fuck away or whatever?
lines.zh: : 明白了。所以{i}你爸{/i}就行，我还是得他妈的躲远点之类的？

lines.en: : At least he didn’t spend every day shooting up heroin while I had to teach myself how to read.
lines.zh: : 至少他没有天天注射海洛因，害我得自己学会认字。

lines.en: : Course not. He just bought it for me while using all of the time {i}I{/i} was lookin’ after you to snort coke with the boys.
lines.zh: : 那当然。他只是出钱给{i}我{/i}买，然后把本该用来照顾你的时间全拿去跟那帮兄弟吸可卡因了。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Probably shouldn’t be sayin’ shit like that with your friend around. Ain’t really used to this.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。你朋友在，我大概不该说这些。我实在不太习惯。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar3
: It’s fine...I kind of know...most of Yumi’s past anyway, so.
lines.zh: : 没关系……我其实也知道……Yumi 过去的那些事，所以。

lines.en: : Ahh. So then you must really fuckin’ hate me, huh?
lines.zh: : 啊。那这么说，你肯定特别他妈恨我咯？

lines.en: : You said it, not me.
lines.zh: : 这话是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: : Ha. Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 哈。很公道。

lines.en: : If you’re looking for money, good fucking luck. Turns out the whole testosterone shortage in Kumon-mi has made us fall upon “hard times,” whatever the fuck that means.
lines.zh: : 你要是来要钱的，祝你好运。结果发现 Kumon-mi 这一带闹「睾酮短缺」，害我们家也陷入「艰难时期」了——管他那话到底什么意思。

lines.en: : I’m good on money. Lot easier to save up when you ain’t blowin’ everything you’ve got on drugs, you know?
lines.zh: : 我不缺钱。不用把什么都砸在毒品上，存钱就轻松多了，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Just gonna make it easier to go out with a bang once you relapse again, you fucking piece of shit.
lines.zh: : 那等你再复吸的时候，死得更痛快就是了，你这坨狗屎。

lines.en: : Damn. You gonna just let her talk to me like that, Chika?
lines.zh: : 操。你就这么由着她跟我说话，Chika？

lines.en: : It’s probably best if I just...don’t really get involved in this.
lines.zh: : 我大概还是……别掺和进来比较好。

lines.en: : Yeah. An enemy of a friend is also...whatever the fuck the phrase is. You know what I’m tryin’ to say.
lines.zh: : 是啊。敌人的敌人也是……管他妈那句话怎么说的。你懂我意思。

lines.en: : Yuki-
lines.zh: : Yuki——

lines.en: : {i}Mom.{/i}
: {i}Yuki,{/i} get the fuck out of here. Chika and I were in the middle of shit and I don’t wanna fuckin’ deal with you anyway.
lines.zh: : {i}Yuki，{/i}滚他妈出去。Chika 和我正说着事呢，而且我压根不想搭理你。

lines.en: : Not even if I buy you dinner?
lines.zh: : 就算我请你吃饭也不行？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar4
: Dinner? Really? You realize I didn’t come here to plan a fucking family reunion, right? I’m just trying to disappear for a little while.
lines.zh: : 吃饭？真的？你该不会以为我是回来张罗什么家庭重聚的吧？我只是想消失一阵子。

lines.en: : Well there ain’t nobody better to learn the art of disappearing from than your absentee mother, right?
lines.zh: : 那要学怎么消失，还有谁比你这位缺席的母亲更适合当老师，对吧？

lines.en: : My dad would probably be better. He’s never come back around to ask {i}me{/i} out to dinner.
lines.zh: : 我爸可能更合适。他可从没回来请{i}我{/i}吃过饭。

lines.en: : Ha! I like this girl. Also, sorry about your dad. Sounds like a prick.
lines.zh: : 哈！我喜欢这姑娘。还有，你爸的事节哀。听着像个混蛋。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar5
: You ain’t helping.
lines.zh: : 你这是在帮倒忙。

lines.en: : I don’t want to help. I think you should go with her.
lines.zh: : 我本来就不想帮。我觉得你应该跟她去。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. You won’t talk to me because you’re afraid of fucking up our friendship or whatever. But you don’t give a shit about losing your mom {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。你不肯跟我谈，是因为怕搞砸我们的友情之类的。可你对自己要失去妈妈这事却{i}一点都不{/i}在乎。

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna air out my worries to someone who would pawn ‘em off for a bag of dope.
lines.zh: : 我才不会把心事倒给一个会拿它们去换一包毒品的人。

lines.en: : Not many people lookin’ to buy teenage drama. Can’t imagine I’d get much for whatever those “worries” of yours may be.
lines.zh: : 想买青少年破事的人可不多。你那些「心事」，我估计也卖不了多少钱。

lines.en: : Think of it as a celebration dinner.
lines.zh: : 就当是顿庆祝晚餐吧。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar6
: The fuck are we celebrating? The fact that I got suspended for beating the living shit out of some girl?
lines.zh: : 庆祝个屁？庆祝我把某个女的打得半死结果被停学？

lines.en: : Yeah. Exactly.
lines.zh: : 对。就是这个。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar7
: Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Yeah. Sounds like you really fucked her up. Bitch probably had it coming.
lines.zh: : 真的。听上去你把她收拾得挺惨。那婊子大概是活该。

lines.en: : You might be a temperamental brat but you’re still my daughter and we got good judgement when it comes to shit like that. Everything else, though? Not so much.
lines.zh: : 你也许是个暴躁的小屁孩，可你依然是我女儿，在这类事上我们的判断力好得很。别的方面嘛，就不怎么样了。

lines.en: : You ain’t, like...ashamed of me or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你不会……为我感到丢人之类的？

lines.en: : Fuck would I be ashamed for? You have any idea how many people {i}I{/i} fucked up when I was your age?
lines.zh: : 我丢什么人？你知道{i}我{/i}在你这个年纪打废过多少人吗？

lines.en: : See, Yumi? Talking to her might not be that bad if you two can hold yourself back from insulting each other every opportunity you get.
lines.zh: : 看吧，Yumi？只要你们俩能忍住别逮着机会就互骂，跟她聊聊也许没那么糟。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar8
: Not gonna lie, that sounds hard as shit.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这听着难如登天。

lines.en: : It probably will be. It’s the first time you two will actually be {i}talking{/i} in...how long?
lines.zh: : 可能会吧。毕竟这是你们俩这……多少年来第一次真正地{i}说话{/i}？

lines.en: : Long fuckin’ time.
lines.zh: : 他妈的老久了。

lines.en: : You know what I’d give to be able to talk to my mom again, Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi，你知道我愿意付出什么才能再跟我妈说上话吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but your mom wasn’t a fucking crackhead.
lines.zh: : 知道，可你妈又不是个该死的瘾君子。

lines.en: : Good point. But still, if {i}I{/i} can’t do anything for you...maybe she can.
lines.zh: : 有道理。但话说回来，如果{i}我{/i}帮不了你什么……也许她能。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar9
: Besides, maybe you’ll even get a refresher on exactly what you {i}don’t{/i} want to be?
lines.zh: : 再说了，说不定你还能趁机复习一下自己到底{i}不想{/i}变成什么样？

lines.en: : Seems like it might be good to get a little wake up call on that front after hearing that you’re tempted to just...throw everything away.
lines.zh: : 听到你说想就这么……把手上的一切全扔掉，我觉得在这件事上被敲打一下也许是好事。

lines.en: : You talkin’ shit, Chika Chosokabe?
lines.zh: : 你在说我坏话吗，Chika Chosokabe？

lines.en: : Bitch, I will fuck you up.
lines.zh: : 婊子，信不信我揍你。

lines.en: : Ha! Yumi, this girl’s even more of a firecracker than you are. Keep her close, got it?
lines.zh: : 哈！Yumi，这丫头比你还火爆。把她看紧点，记住没？

lines.en: : If I agree to this whole...dinner thing...for {i}Chika,{/i} not for you...how do I know you ain’t gonna just make me feel like shit the whole time?
lines.zh: : 如果我答应这顿……饭的事……是为了 {i}Chika{/i}，不是为了你……我怎么知道你不会全程都让我难受得要死？

lines.en: : How ‘bout this? I do somethin’ to piss you off...you get to punch me in the mouth.
lines.zh: : 这样吧？我做了什么惹毛你的事……你就朝我嘴上来一拳。

lines.en: : Every time?
lines.zh: : 每次？

lines.en: : Every time. And I won’t even fight back.
lines.zh: : 每次。而且我绝不还手。

lines.en: : I can work with that.
lines.zh: : 这个我能接受。

lines.en: : I don’t really agree with that...methodology, but I guess it fits the two of you pretty well.
lines.zh: : 我不太认同这个……方法，不过我觉得倒挺适合你们俩的。

lines.en: : Where are we going?
lines.zh: : 我们去哪儿？

lines.en: : Depends. You drink?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你喝酒吗？

lines.en: : Do you even know how old I am?
lines.zh: : 你到底知不知道我多大？

lines.en: : Do you know how old {i}I{/i} am?
lines.zh: : 你知不知道{i}我{/i}多大？

lines.en: : Fucking old. Surprised you’re still breathing, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 老得要死。说实话你居然还活着，我挺意外的。

lines.en: : Heh, same here. Guess we can hit up a dive or something. Either drink or don’t, I don’t give a shit. Will pick a place with food, though.
lines.zh: : 嘿，彼此彼此。要不就去个小馆子什么的吧。喝不喝随便，我才懒得管。不过会挑个有吃的地方。

lines.en: : You coming too, Chika?
lines.zh: : 你也来吗，Chika？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar10

: Me? Oh, no. I think this should be a thing for you two. I should probably start heading home now anyway. Another friend of mine and my teacher are actually babysitting my sister for me at the moment.
lines.zh: : 我？哦，不了。我觉得这该是你俩的事。而且我也该回家了。我另一个朋友和我的老师这会儿正帮我看妹妹呢。

lines.en: : Same teacher as Yumi’s? Tall guy? Glasses?
lines.zh: : 跟 Yumi 是同一个老师？高个子？戴眼镜？

lines.en: : Yeah. You know him?
lines.zh: : 对。你认识他？

lines.en: : Yeah. Saw my tits not that long ago.
lines.zh: : 认识。前阵子刚看过我的奶子。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar11
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Relax. Ain’t like I wanted to show him. Just kinda happened. Guy seems like he likes ‘em a little younger anyway.
lines.zh: : 别紧张。又不是我主动给他看的。就是那么巧。反正那家伙看着就喜欢年纪小的。

lines.en: : Watch your fucking step, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 你他妈说话给我注意点，Yuki。

lines.en: : Damn. You too? Dude’s a straight up player, huh?
lines.zh: : 我靠。你也？这家伙是个彻头彻尾的玩家啊？

lines.en: : We gonna sit here talkin’ about my douchebag ex-teacher all day? Or are you gonna get me some fucking food already?
lines.zh: : 我们就打算坐在这儿聊一整天我那个混蛋前老师？还是你赶紧给我弄点吃的？

lines.en: : Aight, aight. We can go. Only thing is I’ve just got my bike, so you’re probably gonna have to hang on to me if you don’t wanna fall off and die.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我们可以走了。只不过我只骑了摩托，你要是不想摔下去摔死，大概得抱紧我。

lines.en: : Think you can give your mom a hug without trying to kill her?
lines.zh: : 觉得自己能抱一下妈妈而不想弄死她吗？

lines.en: : I think I’ll just hang onto the bike instead.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我还是抓着车算了。

lines.en: scene black
scene yukiyumibar12
: Well this is fuckin’ awkward, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 这可真他妈尴尬，不是吗？

lines.en: : Place is grimy as shit. Can barely even breathe with all the smoke in here. Fits you well.
lines.zh: : 这地方脏得要死。烟味这么大，连气都快喘不上来。挺配你的。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar13
: Yeah. I really lucked out, huh? Just found out about it the other day. Might just become a regular.
lines.zh: : 是。我还真是走运，哈？前几天才发现这地方。搞不好会变成常客。

lines.en: : This ain’t the bar you work at? Remember hearin’ somethin’ like that.
lines.zh: : 这不是你上班的那个酒吧？我记得听说过。

lines.en: : Nah. Place I’m at’s a little nicer than this. Quiet. Ain’t really anything like me.
lines.zh: : 不是。我那地方比这儿好点，安静。其实一点都不像我。

lines.en: : Gotta put on this ridiculous get-up and everything. Can’t even wear my own fuckin’ clothes.
lines.zh: : 还得穿那套蠢得要死的制服，什么都要按规矩来。连自己的衣服都不能穿。

lines.en: : Sounds like a nightmare.
lines.zh: : 听着像噩梦。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar14
: Ain’t that bad, all things considered. Job’s a job. Least I ain’t out on the streets anymore.
lines.zh: : 综合考虑也没那么糟。工作就是工作。至少我不用再睡大街了。

lines.en: : Surprised you didn’t just come back home once {i}I{/i} left.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}走了之后你居然没直接回家，真让我意外。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar15
: Didn’t leave cause of you, Yumi. Wasn’t like that.
lines.zh: : 我不是因为你才走的，Yumi。不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Place wasn’t good for me. Was gonna go insane if I stuck around there any longer.
lines.zh: : 那个地方对我不利。再待下去我要疯的。

lines.en: : So you just abandoned your daughter for your {i}own{/i} benefit? Because things got too hard?
lines.zh: : 所以你就为了{i}自己{/i}把女儿扔下了？因为事情太难了？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar16
: That’s right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Would expect you to do the same, too.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也会这么干。

lines.en: : We might be strong as shit...and we might be able to fight off like five people at once, but the biggest threat to us is always gonna be ourselves. Just sucks cause that’s also what’s most important.
lines.zh: : 我们也许强得要命……也许能一个打五个，但对我们最大的威胁永远是我们自己。操蛋的是，那同时也是最重要的东西。

lines.en: : You lose yourself, you’re as good as done. That’s the kinda shit people don’t ever recover from.
lines.zh: : 你要是把自我弄丢了，就彻底完了。这种事，人是永远恢复不了的。

lines.en: : Oh? I thought you were already on the {i}road to recovery?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦？我还以为你已经在{i}康复的路上{/i}了呢？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar17
: I am. Road’s bumpy as shit, though. And I’ve got no fuckin’ clue where it’s goin’ or what the fuck I’m gonna do if I ever make it to the end.
lines.zh: : 是。可这条路颠得要死。而且我他妈根本不知道它通向哪儿，也不知道真走到头了我该怎么办。

lines.en: : Seemed a hell of a lot safer than the other road I was on, though.
lines.zh: : 不过总比我之前走的那条路安全多了。

lines.en: : Just don’t want you goin’ down that same one.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想你也走上同一条。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar18
: Well, gee. Thanks for waiting until I was already miles down that fuckin’ road before tellin’ me I might wanna turn around.
lines.zh: : 呵，谢了。等我在这条破路上走出好几里地了，你才来告诉我也许该掉头。

lines.en: : Why do you think you’re already “miles down that road?” The fuck have you done apart from givin’ that one girl the beating of a lifetime?
lines.zh: : 你凭什么觉得自己已经「走出好几里地」了？除了把那个女的狠揍了一顿，你还干过什么？

lines.en: : I ain’t a “good” person, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我不是「好」人，Yuki。

lines.en: : Ain’t many “good” people on this planet, so that ain’t a big deal.
lines.zh: : 这世上「好」人本来就不多，所以这没什么大不了。

lines.en: : I fuck with everybody. I ain’t nice to anyone at all. Scrape by sellin’ stolen TVs and scamming kids outta their fuckin’ lunch money for shitty candy that’s, once again, fuckin’ stolen.
lines.zh: : 我谁都耍。对谁都不客气。靠卖偷来的电视、骗小孩子的午饭钱买难吃的糖——那糖也是偷来的——勉强糊口。

lines.en: : Sounds like the start of what could be a lucrative business some day.
lines.zh: : 听上去像是某天能做成大买卖的开端。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar19
: You ain’t gettin’ it! I ain’t done nothing to be proud of! Ain’t done nothing to show I ain’t already on the same path you took to bail on me!
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本没懂！我没干过任何值得骄傲的事！没有任何东西能证明我没走上你当年抛下我时走的那条路！

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar20
: What if I deserve this shit? Deserve bein’ looked at like the fuckin’ scumbag I am?
lines.zh: : 要是我活该呢？活该被当成我这种人渣看待？

lines.en: : Cause deep down, we both know that’s what I really am, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 因为在心底，我们俩都知道我就是这样的人，不是吗？

lines.en: : Beats me. I don’t know shit about you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。我对你一无所知，Yumi。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you weren’t there to learn any of it! The fuck am I supposed to do?!
lines.zh: : 对，因为你根本不在那儿，什么都没学到！我他妈该怎么办？！

lines.en: : Can’t go back to school. My best friend is fuckin’ {i}scared{/i} of me. And everybody else that’s heard of me thinks I’m some...rabid animal who beats the crap out of people for no reason!
lines.zh: : 回不了学校。我最好的朋友他妈的{i}怕{/i}我。其他听说过我的人，都觉得我是个……无缘无故就把人打得半死的疯狗！

lines.en: : That why you called him your {i}ex-{/i}teacher earlier? You can’t go back?
lines.zh: : 所以你刚才才叫他{i}前{/i}老师？你回不去了？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar21
: I guess it’s more like I don’t...want to...
lines.zh: : 我觉得更像是我不……想……

lines.en: : Specially now that I know he’s apparently feedin’ you information about me. No fuckin’ clue how you would’ve even known about this shit otherwise.
lines.zh: : 尤其是现在我知道他好像在给你递我的情报。不然你他妈根本不可能知道这些破事。

lines.en: : Didn’t hear it from him, just FYI. Fight, I heard about from some other girl I know at a local bathhouse. Found out where you {i}were{/i} from Gary.
lines.zh: : 事先声明，不是从他那儿听来的。打架的事是我在本地澡堂认识的另一个女孩说的。你{i}在哪儿{/i}是 Gary 告诉我的。

lines.en: : Fucking Gary.
lines.zh: : 操蛋的 Gary。

lines.en: : Guess that bathhouse is where the whole tits thing comes into play, huh? Makes sense that fucking asshole would go snooping around the girls’ section.
lines.zh: : 那「奶子」这回事也是在澡堂发生的吧？那个混蛋会溜去女汤偷看，倒是说得通。

lines.en: : It’s more like me and some other girls were usin’ the men’s side. Lot more private and I don’t have to fuckin’ stare at people lookin’ down on my tattoo.
lines.zh: : 其实是我和几个女的在用男汤那边。清静多了，也不用看别人盯着我的纹身露出那副眼神。

lines.en: : Well...whatever. Ain’t somethin’ I feel comfortable gettin’ into with you anyway.
lines.zh: : 行吧……随便。反正这事我也不想跟你细说。

lines.en: : Not gonna tell me why you did it?
lines.zh: : 不打算告诉我你为什么动手？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. Rather just forget it.
lines.zh: : 不重要。我宁愿忘掉。

lines.en: : Think you’ll be able to? Seem pretty fucked up over it.
lines.zh: : 你觉得你忘得掉吗？看上去你为这事难受坏了。

lines.en: : You’d probably be fucked up too if somebody came after you like that.
lines.zh: : 要是有人那样找上你，你也会难受。

lines.en: : Worst part is I know I’ve been on the opposite end of that too. Maybe not {i}as{/i} bad, but I’ve still hurt people just because I wanted to. And I didn’t even have a reason 99%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 最糟的是，我知道我自己也站在过对面。也许没{i}那么{/i}过分，可我照样因为想伤人就伤了人。而且 99% 的时候我连个理由都没有。

lines.en: : So this girl you rocked...she had a reason to come after you?
lines.zh: : 所以那个被你揍的女孩……她有理由找上你？

lines.en: : Plenty of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 多的是。

lines.en: : Had it coming, didn’t I? Was only a matter of time before I got a taste of my own medicine.
lines.zh: : 我活该，不是吗？迟早会尝到自己酿的苦果。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar22
: What’s the point of the fireworks if you’re gonna say shit like that? Why go back to the Yamaguchi place at all if you’re already feelin’ the consequences for your actions?
lines.zh: : 你要是打算说这种话，那你惹出那么大动静图什么？既然已经在承担后果了，干嘛还要回山口家？

lines.en: : Just move the fuck on, Yumi. You’re bigger than the shit that you’re gettin’ bogged down by right now. And I ain’t just talkin’ about your tits.
lines.zh: : 往前走吧，Yumi。你比现在拖垮你的那些破事要强。我说的不只是你那对奶子。

lines.en: : Why is everyone commenting on my tits today?
lines.zh: : 今天怎么人人都评论我的奶子？

lines.en: : Jealousy, maybe? Sure as hell piss {i}me{/i} off. Fuckin’ degrading when your own daughter beats you out like that.
lines.zh: : 大概是嫉妒吧？{i}我{/i}反正是他妈被气到了。被亲生女儿比下去，真是丢人。

lines.en: : Would be nice to {i}move on...{/i}just not really sure if I can. Thought starting over might be easier.
lines.zh: : 我也想{i}往前走……{/i}只是不太确定自己能不能做到。我原以为重新开始会容易些。

lines.en: : Picked the wrong fuckin’ place to do that, if you ask me. Guess it’s not like I can talk, though.
lines.zh: : 要我说，你挑的地方可他妈大错特错。不过我也没资格说这话。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar23
: Yakuza’s still the Yakuza at the end of the day. Crime. Drugs. The whole nine yards. Ain’t shit somebody your age should be around.
lines.zh: : 黑帮到头来还是黑帮。犯罪。毒品。全套都齐。你这年纪不该碰这些。

lines.en: : You had no problem with me bein’ around all that shit when I was a baby, did you?
lines.zh: : 我还是个婴儿的时候，你让我待在那堆破事里可一点意见都没有。

lines.en: : I ain’t the same person I was back then. Want better for you now.
lines.zh: : 我已经不是当年那个人了。现在想让你过得好点。

lines.en: : Know how badly you don’t wanna be like me...and I get that. I {i}agree.{/i} I don’t want you to be like me either.
lines.zh: : 我知道你有多不想变成我这样……我懂。我也{i}同意{/i}。我也不想你变成我。

lines.en: : Which is why I feel like it’s my job to try and stop that shit from happening. Whether or not I deserve that job is another story entirely, though.
lines.zh: : 所以我觉得，我有责任去阻止那种事发生。至于我配不配担这份责任，那就是另一回事了。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar24

: More I thought about it, the more I realized you probably wouldn’t have gone back to that place unless you felt like you {i}had{/i} to. You’re way too stubborn and angsty to just drop by for a visit.
lines.zh: : 我越想越觉得，你要不是觉得自己{i}没别的办法{/i}，大概不会回那个地方。你太倔又太别扭，不可能只是顺路去看看。

lines.en: : Probably oversteppin’ by admittin’ this and talkin’ to you like a real parent...but you can talk to me, you know.
lines.zh: : 承认这个、还像个真正的家长一样跟你说话，可能算是越界了……但你可以跟我说的，你知道。

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna judge you the way others will. I know damn well what it’s like to feel like the whole world’s against you.
lines.zh: : 我不会像别人那样评判你。我太清楚被全世界针对是什么感觉了。

lines.en: : But even if you don’t want one, you’ve got an ally in me.
lines.zh: : 但就算你不想要，你也有我这个盟友。

lines.en: : Just worried that one day it’s gonna be you sittin’ in my spot...talkin’ to some girl {i}you{/i} abandoned because you turned left when you should’ve turned right.
lines.zh: : 我只是担心有朝一日，坐在我这个位置上的人会是你……对着某个{i}你{/i}抛下的女孩说话，因为你在该右转的时候左转了。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar25
: I’d never do that...
lines.zh: : 我绝不会那样……

lines.en: : Never make the same mistakes you did...
lines.zh: : 绝不会犯你犯过的错……

lines.en: : I’m better than that.
lines.zh: : 我比那强。

lines.en: : Damn right you are. Should be happy I set the bar so low. Will be easier to get over.
lines.zh: : 他妈说得太对了。你该庆幸我把标准定得这么低。这样更容易跨过去。

lines.en: : Gee, thanks. I totally understand why you fucked up so badly now.
lines.zh: : 呵，谢了。我现在完全理解你为什么能搞砸到这种地步了。

lines.en: : Hey, just doin’ my part as family, you know?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我这是在尽家人的本分，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Even if we don’t stick together, we’ve gotta have each other’s backs when it matters most.
lines.zh: : 就算我们不在一起，关键时刻也得互相撑着。

lines.en: : And if you ever wind up havin’ to kick the shit out of some other girl who comes at you, give me a call first next time. Could give you a few pointers.
lines.zh: : 还有，下次你要是又得把找上门的哪个女的打得满地找牙，先给我打个电话。我能教你几招。

lines.en: : You’ve got a weird fucking idea of how family is supposed to work, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你对「家人该怎么运作」的理解，真他妈奇怪。

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, we’re a weird fuckin’ family, ain’t we?
lines.zh: : 是啊。那我们本来就是个奇怪的家庭，不是吗？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar26
: Aunt Yukiburger! Prolonged use of tiny nicotine cylinders will cause your fleshy air balloons to turn black and fill with tar! You said you would stop!
lines.zh: : Yukiburger 阿姨！长期使用微型尼古丁圆柱体将导致您的肉质气球变黑并充满焦油！您说过您会戒的！

lines.en: : Hey, I didn’t bitch when you took your sweet ass time coming over here, Kaori. Least you could do is let me get lung cancer in peace without making me feel like a dick about it.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你磨磨蹭蹭才过来，我可一句都没抱怨，Kaori。至少让我安安静静地得个肺癌，别让我觉得自己像个混蛋。

lines.en: : I can only be in so many places at once! You will need to wait your turn!
lines.zh: : 我可不能同时出现在那么多地方！请您排队等着！

lines.en: : K...Kaori?
lines.zh: : K……Kaori？

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar27
: How do you know my name?! I have already told you people, the instant gram is no more!
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我的名字？！我已经跟你们说过了，那个即时 gram 已经不复存在！

lines.en: : Probably heard me say it five seconds ago. Ain’t a big deal, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 大概是五秒钟前听我说的吧。我觉得没什么大不了。

lines.en: : ‘Less she wants it to be, that is.
lines.zh: : 除非她想让它变成大事。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar28
: The way your glossy sight balls connect with mine tells me you are not who I perceived you to be at first.
lines.zh: : 你那光亮的视觉球体与我相接的方式告诉我，你并非我最初所感知的那个人。

lines.en: : My communication with humans is very limited outside of business hours...which can only mean that I have forgotten you...
lines.zh: : 我与人类的沟通在营业时间之外非常有限……这只能说明我已经把你忘了……

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar29
: Or are you stalking me! Like a tall stick of beans!
lines.zh: : 或者你在跟踪我！像一根高高的豆茎！

lines.en: : A...what?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么？

lines.en: : I will not purchase your beans! I already have too many!
lines.zh: : 我不会买你的豆子！我已经有太多了！

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar30
: I have many things to do now!
lines.zh: : 我现在有很多事要做！

lines.en: : Hello!
lines.zh: : 你好！

lines.en: : What the fuck was that?...
lines.zh: : 那他妈是什么玩意儿？……

lines.en: : Oh yeah. Kaori’s still alive, by the way.
lines.zh: : 哦对。顺便说一句，Kaori 还活着。

lines.en: : I knew she was still alive. I just wasn’t expecting to see her here and...was also not expecting her to talk like a fucking alien.
lines.zh: : 我知道她还活着。我只是没想到会在这儿碰见她，而且……也没想到她说话像个外星人。

lines.en: : You get used to it after a little while. Sure she’d be happy to talk to you if you actually explained to her who you are.
lines.zh: : 过一阵子你就习惯了。你要是真跟她解释清楚你是谁，她肯定乐意跟你聊。

lines.en: : Parents are dead after all. Doesn’t really talk to anybody other than me and your {i}ex-{/i}teacher now. One more friend wouldn’t hurt her.
lines.zh: : 她父母都不在了。现在除了我和你那位{i}前{/i}老师，基本不跟别人说话。多一个朋友对她没坏处。

lines.en: : I ain’t really lookin’ for more friends right now...
lines.zh: : 我现在真没打算再交朋友……

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar31
: Ain’t lookin’ for family either, are you?
lines.zh: : 也没打算找家人，对吧？

lines.en: : No...I’m not...
lines.zh: : 没有……我没打算……

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar32
: Uhh...
: Tha...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……

lines.en: : Oh, shut the fuck up. You don’t have to actually say it. You’re down enough as-is. Doubt thanking the woman who helped make you into the mess you are will help at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，闭嘴吧。你不用真的说出来。你已经够低落了。去感谢那个把你造就成现在这副烂摊子的女人，我怀疑也帮不上什么忙。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah, I’m just gonna keep my mouth shut. Ain’t wastin’ unnecessary words on a piece of shit like you.
lines.zh: : 是，我还是闭嘴吧。不值得在你这种人渣身上浪费多余的话。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t mean much coming from a piece of shit like {i}you{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 从{i}你{/i}这种人渣嘴里说出来的话，也没什么分量。

lines.en: scene yukiyumibar33
: It really wouldn’t...would it?
lines.zh: : 确实没什么分量……对吧？

lines.en: : I’m fucking starving...
lines.zh: : 我饿死了……

lines.en: scene black
scene bedroom_night
: Hello?
: Yo.
: Yuki? Isn’t it a little late for you to be calling?
lines.zh: : Yuki？你这个点打电话是不是有点晚了？

lines.en: : The fuck you mean “late?” You goin’ to sleep already, you little puss?
lines.zh: : 「晚了」你他妈什么意思？你这就睡了，小怂包？

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是吧。

lines.en: : Anyway, just wanted to let you know I talked to Yumi for a bit today.
lines.zh: : 总之，就是想告诉你，我今天跟 Yumi 聊了一会儿。

lines.en: : What? Really? She actually talked to you?
lines.zh: : 什么？真的？她真的跟你说话了？

lines.en: : For an hour or two, yeah. Got dinner at some dive bar and talked a little about the shit that went down at school with her.
lines.zh: : 聊了一两个小时吧，嗯。在个小馆子吃了顿饭，聊了点在学校里出的那档子事。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t tell me much, of course. But it was nice actually bein’ able to hold a conversation with her for the first time in...actually, probably ever.
lines.zh: : 当然，她没告诉我多少。不过能真的跟她好好说上话，感觉还真不错——这么多年来的第一次……其实大概是有生以来第一次。

lines.en: : Well, I’m happy for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我为你高兴。

lines.en: : My day was horrible.
lines.zh: : 我今天过得糟透了。

lines.en: : Hah! And why’s that?
lines.zh: : 哈！怎么了？

lines.en: : I started a family.
lines.zh: : 我成家了。

lines.en: : Damn.
lines.zh: : 我靠。

lines.en: : Don’t let Sara know. Don’t wanna see her cry.
lines.zh: : 别让 Sara 知道。不想看她哭。

lines.en: : If I’m lucky, I will no longer be a part of the family by tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 运气好的话，明天我就不再是这个家的一员了。

lines.en: : Yeah, startin’ to sound like my day was a little better.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这么听起来我这一天还算过得不错。

lines.en: : But yeah, just wanted to let you know that shit happened in case you were worried about her. Still ain’t convinced you two aren’t fucking.
lines.zh: : 不过，就是想跟你说一声这事儿，省得你担心她。我还是不信你们俩没在搞。

lines.en: : Yuki-
lines.zh: : Yuki——

lines.en: : Also, told me to tell you to not come looking for her. Fucking tsundere, that girl.
lines.zh: : 还有，她让我转告你别来找她。这丫头，真是个傲娇。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’d be able to find her anyway. She’s gotten too good at avoiding me.
lines.zh: : 反正我也找不到她。她躲我躲得越来越熟练了。

lines.en: : You stalkin’ my daughter, man?
lines.zh: : 你在跟踪我女儿，老兄？

lines.en: : Only when I have to.
lines.zh: : 只在必要的时候。

lines.en: : Well, give her space for now or some shit. She’ll probably find you when she’s ready. Just takin’ a little while to cool off, I think.
lines.zh: : 行吧，那就先给她点空间什么的。等她准备好了，大概会自己来找你。我想她只是需要点时间消消气。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’ve gotta head back to my apartment. Got a new neighbor movin’ in next door tonight and I don’t want my bike wakin’ ‘em up and shit.
lines.zh: : 总之，我得回公寓了。今晚隔壁要搬来个新邻居，我可不想让我的摩托车吵醒人家。

lines.en: : Sure. Thanks for...letting me know what’s going on with Yumi, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧。谢你……告诉我 Yumi 的情况。

lines.en: : And congratulations, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 还有，恭喜你，Yuki。

lines.en: : Heh.
: Thanks, man...
lines.zh: : 谢了，老兄……

lines.en: : Appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 这份心意我领了。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and toss it onto my bed, unsure of exactly what this means for my relationship with Yumi.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，把它扔到床上，说不清这对我和 Yumi 的关系究竟意味着什么。

lines.en: But I guess I don’t really deserve any form of certainty after failing to properly stand up for her back in the locker room.
lines.zh: 不过，既然我在更衣室里没能好好为她出头，我想我本来也不配得到任何确定性。

lines.en: I’d avoid me if I were her as well.
lines.zh: 要是我是她，我也会躲着我。

lines.en: scene black
But, then again...
lines.zh: 可是，话说回来……

lines.en: I probably would have never gotten to know me in the first place.
lines.zh: 我大概从一开始就不会认识我。

lines.en: How unfortunate that she did.
lines.zh: 她认识了，真是不幸。
